subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: Asymptomatic Bacteriuria, Malaria and Zika in Pregnancy

steps.tx: Bacteria in urine without symptoms, treated in pregnancy unlike outside it, is **asymptomatic bacteriuria**. Untreated, up to thirty percent ascend to pyelonephritis with preterm labour risk. A single culture at booking catches most cases. Counts of one hundred thousand organisms per millilitre of a single species define the result on culture.
steps.say: Asymptomatic bacteriuria is treated in pregnancy because thirty percent ascend to pyelonephritis.

steps.tx: Kidney infection in pregnancy causing fever, loin pain and sepsis risk is acute **pyelonephritis**. It is the commonest serious medical admission in pregnancy. Intravenous antibiotics and hydration, with thromboprophylaxis, form treatment. Right sided pain dominates because the right ureter dilates more, and acute respiratory distress is a recognised complication.
steps.say: Pyelonephritis is the commonest serious medical admission in pregnancy.

steps.tx: Fever parasite infection causing anaemia, hypoglycaemia and placental failure in pregnancy is **malaria in pregnancy**. Placental sequestration hides parasites from blood films. Intermittent preventive treatment and bed nets protect women in endemic areas, and severe disease needs artesunate. Falciparum malaria in pregnancy can drop glucose dangerously, and quinine treatment itself provokes hypoglycaemia.
steps.say: Malaria in pregnancy sequesters in the placenta causing anaemia and growth failure.

steps.tx: Mosquito borne virus causing microcephaly through fetal brain destruction is the **Zika virus**. Sexual transmission also occurs, so partner travel history matters. No vaccine or treatment exists, making prevention and surveillance the response. Microcephaly risk concentrates in first trimester infection, and serial head growth scans follow confirmed cases.
steps.say: Zika virus destroys fetal brain causing microcephaly, with prevention the only response.

steps.tx: Fifth disease virus suppressing fetal red cell production is **parvovirus B19** in pregnancy terms. Weekly Doppler watches for anaemia for eight to twelve weeks after exposure. Most exposed pregnancies end normally. Mirror syndrome, maternal oedema mirroring a hydropic fetus, is rare but signals severe fetal anaemia.
steps.say: Parvovirus B19 suppresses fetal red cells and needs eight weeks of Doppler watching.

steps.tx: Urinary infection recurrence prevention uses post treatment test of cure cultures, called **test of cure**. Persistent bacteriuria prompts low dose prophylaxis for the pregnancy. Nitrofurantoin avoidance near term and trimethoprim avoidance early shape drug choice. A repeat culture one week after treatment finishes is the test, and persistent growth means a urinary tract cause hunt.
steps.say: Test of cure after bacteriuria treatment catches persistence needing prophylaxis.

steps.tx: Group B streptococcus in urine at any count marks heavy colonisation needing **intrapartum prophylaxis** automatically. It also treats as urinary infection at diagnosis in pregnancy. The neonatal team is alerted on the delivery plan. Benzylpenicillin in labour is first choice, with clindamycin reserved for true penicillin allergy by local sensitivity.
steps.say: Group B streptococcus bacteriuria automatically mandates intrapartum prophylaxis.

steps.tx: Listeria from soft cheese and deli meats causes flu like illness with fetal loss, prevented by **food hygiene advice**. Pregnant women avoid unpasteurised products and refrigerated pates. Blood cultures diagnose febrile cases and ampicillin treats. Ampicillin for seven to ten days treats maternal listeriosis and crosses to treat the fetus as well.
steps.say: Food hygiene advice prevents listeria, which causes fetal loss from soft cheese.

steps.tx: Fever in pregnancy always earns a cause hunt because maternal sepsis kills quickly, following **fever workup discipline**. Cultures before antibiotics, lactate and senior review mirror sepsis bundles. The fetus tolerates maternal fever poorly, so antipyretics accompany antibiotics. Temperature above 38 degrees twice, or once above 39, starts the bundle clock in most maternity sepsis pathways.
steps.say: Fever workup discipline hunts the cause quickly because maternal sepsis kills fast.
